key_insight: FL4N proposes a feed-forward model that represents a dynamic 3D scene in a unified latent space rather than with explicit 4D primitives. The goal is to generate views across camera positions and time while avoiding temporal inconsistencies and rendering artifacts.
problem_solved: Reconstructing dynamic scenes from monocular input requires inferring both 3D structure and motion. Existing feed-forward methods based on explicit 4D Gaussian representations can produce inconsistent motion and severe visual artifacts.
method: Use a feed-forward model for 4D novel view synthesis across viewpoints and timestamps.
Encode a 4D scene prior in a unified latent representation instead of explicit 4D primitives.
Further architecture and training details are not available in the provided, truncated abstract.
impact: FL4N introduces an alternative representation for dynamic-scene rendering that could improve temporal consistency and visual quality. The provided excerpt does not include quantitative results or runtime measurements.
